name: PODOPHYLLINUM
key_symptoms: Hot, sour belching; nausea and vomiting. Thirst for large quantities of cold water (Bry). Vomiting of hot, frothy mucus. Heartburn; gagging or empty retching. Vomiting of milk.

Vertigo, with tendency to fall forward. Headache, dull pressure, worse morning, with heated face and bitter taste; alternating with diarrhśa. Rolling of head from side to side, moaning and vomiting and eyelids half closed. Child perspires on head during sleep.
Pain between shoulders, under right scapula, in loins and lumbar region. Pain in right inguinal region; shoots down inner thigh to knees. Paralytic weakness on left side.

mind_symptoms: Loquacity and delirium from eating acid fruits. Depression of spirits.
head_symptoms: Vertigo, with tendency to fall forward. Headache, dull pressure, worse morning, with heated face and bitter taste; alternating with diarrhśa. Rolling of head from side to side, moaning and vomiting and eyelids half closed. Child perspires on head during sleep.
gi_symptoms: Hot, sour belching; nausea and vomiting. Thirst for large quantities of cold water (Bry). Vomiting of hot, frothy mucus. Heartburn; gagging or empty retching. Vomiting of milk.
urinary_symptoms: Pain in uterus and right ovary, with shifting noises along ascending colon. Suppressed menses, with pelvic tenesmus. Prolapsed uteri, especially after parturition. Hćmorrhoids, with prolapsus ani during pregnancy.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain between shoulders, under right scapula, in loins and lumbar region. Pain in right inguinal region; shoots down inner thigh to knees. Paralytic weakness on left side.
fever_symptoms: Chill at 7 am, with pain in hypochondria, and knees, ankles, wrists, Great loquacity during fever. Profuse sweat.
